Subject: Portal tax ID mismatch and MSA redline timeline

Hi Tanya —

Quick note from the onboarding side: when we attempted to create the MedSys vendor record in Ariba this morning the system rejected the entry because the Tax ID on the vendor profile doesn’t match the legal name on the DUNS/registration. I pulled a short summary (attached) showing the two values we received from your team versus the company registry.

Two asks so we can keep the activation moving:
- Can you confirm the correct Tax ID and legal entity name we should use in Ariba? If you can attach a signed W-9 (or local equivalent) that will let us reconcile the profile immediately.
- Second, our legal team will need to run the MSA redline against the latest order form mapping before we open purchase orders. What is your target turnaround for reviewing redlines? We typically aim for an initial legal response within 2 business days for straightforward edits, but want to sync expectations.

I attached a short spreadsheet with the field mismatch and the Ariba field names that must match exactly ("Tax ID Number", "Legal Name"). If you’d prefer, I can set up a 20-minute call with Marissa and Rishi to walk through the portal fields and the MSA timeline.

Thanks — appreciate the quick confirmation so procurement can proceed.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Program Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks for flagging this. Sorry for the friction — I attached the signed W-9 and our internal vendor profile export showing the company legal name and tax ID we use:
- Legal name: MedSys Health Inc.
- Tax ID: 12-3456789

attachment: MedSys_W9.pdf (pdf)

A couple of notes from procurement:
- Our Ariba instance enforces an exact match on Tax ID + Legal Name. If there’s any aliasing (DBAs) we need the legal entity record.
- On redlines: we can circulate the MSA edits to our counsel (James Fleming) the same day. Typical turnaround from our side is 3–5 business days for negotiated items; trivial edits often come back in 24–48 hrs.

If you want to expedite the PO activation we can pre-provision the vendor record as "pending tax verification" and allow PO submission once legal confirms the MSA/orderform state. Happy to join a quick call — Sam is our procurement lead and will be on the thread.

Best,
Tanya Rao
Vendor Onboarding Lead, MedSys Health

Chloe / Rishi —

Thanks for the context and the W-9. Legal has capacity to take an initial pass on the MSA today but we should align on our position ahead of sending it to MedSys counsel. I recommend the following approach:

1) Intake (today): Legal will do a redline pass and populate the redline tracker (attached). We will accept the majority of commercial edits on the order form (pricing/table mapping) but will flag two areas for escalation: indemnity carveouts and data handling (audit log / retention).
2) Response window (MedSys): ask for 3 business days for their counter, but offer 24–48 hr turnaround on clarifying questions to keep momentum.
3) Portal gating: Procurement can pre-provision the Ariba vendor record as "pending verification" if Tanya/Sam confirm the W-9 matches the legal registry value. That allows the buyer to submit a PO that will be held until the tax match is confirmed and contract countersigned.

Action items:
- Chloe: confirm the DUNS/legal registry name and paste the registry link in the thread (so procurement can reconcile).
- Rishi: I’ll assign the redline to Legal (priority: high) and update the tracker by EOD.
- Chloe/Marissa: if MedSys pushes back on indemnity we may need a short negotiation call with James Fleming.

1) Tax/registry: MedSys confirmed the legal name and attached W-9 (thanks Tanya). Tanya — can you paste the registry/DUNS URL here or confirm you want us to use the attached values? Procurement will pre-provision as pending once you confirm.
2) Legal redline: Marissa will push an initial redline to James and copy Rishi. Target: initial redline to James by EOD today; turnaround expectation from MedSys counsel 3 biz days.
3) Portal flow: Sam/Tanya — we will create a "pending verification" vendor in Ariba so a PO can be created but held until tax verification + contract signature complete. That avoids blocking upcoming SOW work while keeping controls in place.

I’ll open a short calendar invite for a 20-minute sync tomorrow morning only if anyone prefers a live walk-through — otherwise we’ll proceed asynchronously.
